stories.title: Tesla Sends Cybercab on a 12-Stop Europe Tour Starting in Zürich
stories.summary: Tesla Europe announced a 12-stop public display tour for its Cybercab, starting November 5 at Autoshow Zürich and running through January. The tour visits Germany, Central Europe, and Brussels, with most stops at Tesla stores and three at auto shows. Tesla stated the event is a display only, with no mention of rides, sales, or a Robotaxi timeline in Europe.

stories.title: Ukraine launches competition to develop radars, forms closer ties with NATO
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence of Ukraine, the Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine and the Brave1 defence technology cluster are launching grant competitions to develop Ukrainian radars and air-to-air missiles. Deputy Minister of Defence of Ukraine Sergiy Boyev and representatives of NATO’s Defence Innovation Accelerator for the North Atlantic (DIANA) signed a memorandum of understanding to expand cooperation in the joint development, testing and adoption of innovative technologies.

stories.title: Taiwan Fines Startup for Botched Counter-Drone Project
stories.summary: Taiwan’s military imposed penalties of more than 140 million New Taiwan dollars ($4.3 million) on local defense startup Tron Future for failing to deliver on a counter-drone procurement contract. The ministry stated that Tron’s system proved entirely ineffective, with both passive radar and jamming systems failing to detect and neutralize incoming aircraft.

stories.title: Russia Deploying Rare MiG-35 Fighters for Low Cost Air Defence Against Ukrainain Drones
stories.summary: The Russian Aerospace Forces began using MiG-35 fighters to intercept Ukrainian long-range unmanned aerial vehicles attacking targets deep inside Russian territory. With only six of the aircraft believed to have been produced, their reported use in homeland air defence illustrates the growing demands Ukrainian long-range strikes are placing on Russian military resources.

stories.title: RailOne to establish concrete railroad tie factory in North Bay
stories.summary: RailOne Rainbow Canada Corp. is building a concrete railroad tie manufacturing facility in North Bay with $1 million in provincial funding from the Northern Ontario Heritage Fund Corporation. The project is expected to create 19 jobs and establish Ontario’s first facility to manufacture concrete ties for transit projects, using technology developed in Germany to reduce reliance on imported products.

stories.title: Russian forces launch 190+ drones in overnight attack against Ukraine
stories.summary: Russian forces launched 193 Shahed, jet-powered Shahed, and Gerbera UAVs, along with Parodiya decoy drones, against Ukraine overnight on November 2, the Air Force reported. As of 8:00 a.m. local time, Air Defense Forces shot down or neutralized 154 enemy UAVs, 58 of which were jet-powered drones.

stories.title: Australia unveils secretive Ghost Shark underwater drone payloads
stories.summary: Australian military officials revealed three Ghost Shark payloads at Anduril Australia’s Sydney manufacturing center on Oct. 19: sea mines, Altius-600 loitering munitions, and logistics supply caches. Canberra is spending A$1.7 billion on the fleet, with the first unit handed over for testing in early 2026.

stories.title: NATO pushes faster counter-drone defenses and AI-enabled targeting as threats evolve
stories.summary: NATO held the NATO FUSE event in Latvia on October 29-30, bringing together more than 30 countries and over 100 companies to test counter-drone and targeting concepts. The alliance aims to reduce information-to-decision latency by more than 50% while retaining human authority over engagement decisions.

stories.title: UK and Ukrainian Industry Unite to Accelerate Drone Innovation
stories.summary: Minister for the Armed Forces, Louise Sandher-Jones, said, "Ukraine’s security is Europe’s security." The event explored opportunities for collaboration, co-development and investment in uncrewed aerial systems (UAS) and related technologies, building ties between British and Ukrainian stakeholders.

stories.title: France orders new VTOL version of U010 Aliaca drone
stories.summary: Airbus announced on October 29 that France has ordered the VTOL version of the U010 Aliaca drone for naval operations. The DGA placed an initial order for the VTOL variant, which will equip BSAMs in late 2026 and BSAOMs during 2027.

stories.title: China accelerates race to develop smarter humanoid robots
stories.summary: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reported that the country developed more than 400 humanoid robot models and produced over 40,000 units by the end of June 2026. The ministry expects annual production to surpass 100,000 units in 2026, with robots being tested in more than 300 priority application scenarios.

stories.title: Meet Nyiko the dancing robot: A gift to robotics research and innovation
stories.summary: The Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) AI Hub named its second humanoid robot Nyiko, a Unitree R1 bipedal model developed by Unitree Robotics. The addition joins the Unitree G1 and quadruped robot Dexter in the university's collection, supporting research in adaptive decision-making and artificial intelligence (AI) aligned with South Africa's Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Decadal Plan (2022–2032).

stories.title: DroneShield Wins a Place in the US Army's Counter-Drone Framework — but the Contract Math Is Not What It Seems
stories.summary: The U.S. Army awarded DroneShield and six other suppliers places on a counter-drone procurement framework with a US$7 billion overall ceiling. DroneShield reported committed sales of A$261 million for fiscal 2026 and set November 3, 2026, for the release of DroneSentry-C2.

stories.title: Russia hit by another drone attack: Fire reported at Samara oil hub
stories.summary: Drones struck the Samara linear production and dispatch station in Prosvet on November 2, triggering a fire. This marks the third recent attack on the oil hub, which holds one of Europe's largest tank farms.

also.title: Drones Strike Samara Facility, Home to Europe’s Largest Tank Farm

stories.title: Calls for 'severe' deterrents after Jersey Airport drone disruption
stories.summary: People have called for deterrents to be "severe" to prevent drones being flown illegally at Jersey Airport, which has led to disrupted and diverted flights. Flights were affected on Friday and Saturday evenings after unauthorised drone activity was reported, leading to services being cancelled or diverted to other airports, including Paris.

stories.title: UCPD acquires over $200,000 worth of drones, less-than-lethal weaponry
stories.summary: UCPD acquired $220,020 worth of drones and less-than-lethal munitions in 2025 and is requesting additional equipment, the department said in its Oct. 19 military equipment report. The purchase includes three Skydio X10 drones for a new Drone as First Responder program, while the department seeks 1,950 additional PepperBall rounds and 50 more 40 mm projectiles.

stories.title: RoboParty Launches RP1, a Full-Stack Open-Source Humanoid Robot
stories.summary: RoboParty launched RP1, a full-stack open-source humanoid robot available in 24 and 30 degree-of-freedom versions for embodied AI research. The robot supports continuous walking, fall recovery, and human motion tracking, with an open toolchain spanning data collection, simulation training, and physical deployment.

stories.title: Zuckerberg Wants To Give AI A Body. Meet Meta's New Humanoid Robot
stories.summary: Meta partnered with Chinese robotics startup Fourier to build a humanoid prototype called Max in three months, utilizing Fourier's hardware and customizing its height, hands, and display. The 48-kilo robot runs on Nvidia's Jetson Thor platform and is intended for internal research, with a second version already in development.

also.title: Meta partners with Chinese firm Fourier to build humanoid robot prototype in three months

stories.title: IL Group Showcases Humanoid Robots Validated on Real Injection Molding Line
stories.summary: IL Corp. and IL Robotics will exhibit at RoboWorld 2026 from the 4th through the 7th of this month at Hall 1 of KINTEX in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province. IL is verifying its process-deployment technology using an operating injection molding line at IL Mobility, while IL Robotics will perform group dance routines with IL BOT H2 and Y1 robots three times daily.

stories.title: World rail contract news round-up
stories.summary: Siemens Mobility secured a contract worth more than €2bn for 113 Mireo Plus B battery-electric multiple-units and two new depots in Germany. The company will maintain the fleet for 30 years.

stories.title: Who Pays When a Robotaxi Crashes? The Liability Question Regulators Haven’t Answered
stories.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) opened a preliminary evaluation of Waymo’s automated driving system in 2024 after a series of incidents, including collisions with stationary objects and vehicles behaving unexpectedly near school buses, and has since expanded its review. Waymo has issued software recalls in response.

stories.title: Gallium Defense raises €7.1M to develop lower-cost drone detection radar
stories.summary: Hamburg-based deep tech startup MuRay raised €7.1 million to develop an industrial imaging system capable of seeing through dense materials.

stories.title: Raytheon awarded $729 million in counter-drone contracts
stories.summary: Raytheon, an RTX business, was awarded $729 million to deliver components of the LIDS counter-drone system to the U.S. Army, Qatar, and Jordan. The contract includes the first international sales of the KuRFS sensor and Coyote effector, with RTX investing to expand production and integrate upgrades for faster launch times, higher speeds, and greater range.

stories.title: 'Suspicious object' enters Latvian airspace near Belarus, Russia border
stories.summary: Latvian armed forces announced that a flying object briefly entered the country's airspace near the Russia and Belarus border on Nov. 1. The military deployed a BLAZE interceptor drone, which activated its self-destruct protocol to avoid violating Russian or Belarusian airspace.

also.title: Latvia Uses BLAZE Interceptor Drone for First Time Against Unidentified Object Near Russian Border

stories.title: ​Ukrainian Interceptor Drone Shoots Down russian Shahed Drone in Footage Captured by Two UAVs
stories.summary: Operators of Ukraine's Raid 413th Regiment detected and destroyed a russian Shahed-type attack drone, with the interception captured simultaneously by two different unmanned aerial vehicles. The footage shows the Ukrainian interceptor drone engaging the target in mid-air, providing a rare dual-viewpoint perspective on the engagement.

stories.title: Russia opens terrorism case after drone attack in Nizhny Novgorod
stories.summary: Russia’s Investigative Committee opened a criminal case under the terrorism statute after a drone attack in Nizhny Novgorod Region damaged an industrial facility and civilian infrastructure. Regional Governor Gleb Nikitin said more than 100 drones were destroyed, while officials reported no casualties and warned of possible power outages.

stories.title: Amazon Drones Now Deliver Packages Across Nampa, Star, And Meridian
stories.summary: Amazon announced that its drone fleet is now operational in Nampa, Idaho, with a range of seven and a half miles covering Nampa, Star, and Meridian.

stories.title: Aei Robot sounds China alarm after Robot World win
stories.summary: South Korean developer Aei Robot won a top prize at Robot World 2026 for its Alice 5 robot and warned that Chinese machines hold more than 95 percent of the global humanoid market. The company called for policy support to foster domestic humanoid technology.

stories.title: Robotic layout moves the surveyor's job to control and checking
stories.summary: GIM International reported in a 2026 review that robotic layout shifts surveyor duties to establishing control networks and spot-checking machine marks. The review notes autonomy is most advanced in offshore, underground, and utility-scale solar layout, where high risk and cost drive adoption.

stories.title: Defense ministry launches new drone headquarters to bolster unmanned capabilities amid N.K. threats
stories.summary: South Korea's defense ministry launched a new drone headquarters in Pocheon on Monday to replace the existing Drone Operations Command and coordinate drone strategies across all armed services. The ministry plans to rapidly acquire over 20,000 low-cost, expendable combat drones and accelerate the deployment of the Korean Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (K-LUCAS) program.

stories.title: Prospects for strategic cooperation between Vietnam and Italy in the field of robotics.
stories.summary: Nguyen Nhu Toan, a doctoral student at the University of Bologna, stated that the shift to intelligent robots and the European Union's policy efforts are opening potential for close cooperation between Vietnam and Italy. He noted that VinRobotics introduced the VR-H3 humanoid robot at ICRA 2026 and Phenikaa-X deployed an autonomous robot at the Samsung factory in Thai Nguyen.

stories.title: Transnet Freight Rail ran an empty 696-wagon train about 7.6 km long to Loop 18 on October 18, synchronising its electric and diesel locomotives by radio so braking forces spread through the train, and claims a world record.
stories.summary: Transnet Freight Rail ran an empty 696-wagon train, reported to be about 7.6 km long, along South Africa’s Iron Ore Export Line on 18 October 2026. The company claims this is the longest freight train ever operated, surpassing a 2001 record, though independent certification has yet to be confirmed.

stories.title: Aidin Robotics to Launch Second-Generation Robot Hand This Year
stories.summary: Aidin Robotics is preparing AIDIN Hand Gen2, a second-generation robot hand with sensors across the front of the hand and built-in control functions, targeting a formal launch late this year.

stories.title: Vertical Aerospace Pushes Valo Certification to 2029 as UK eVTOL Hiring Stays Focused on Build-Phase Engineering Roles
stories.summary: Vertical Aerospace moved the certification target for its Valo aircraft from 2028 to 2029 on 13 July 2026, citing the rigour of certifying a new aircraft class. The company reported about $134 million in cash and roughly $100 million in new financing commitments on 13 August, providing at least 12 months of runway.

stories.title: Faraday Future Founder and Global CEO YT Jia Shares Weekly Investor Update: FFR Sold and Shipped 351 Robot
stories.summary: Faraday Future sold and shipped 351 robot devices in October, setting a monthly record and bringing cumulative sales to 1,168 units. The company expects average monthly sales of more than 400 units in November and December to reach its full-year guidance of approximately 2,000 devices.

stories.title: Harassed by Russian drones, Ukraine’s trains keep on rolling
stories.summary: Ukrzaliznytsia reported that Russia attacked more than 1,700 rail facilities this year, while Ukraine's infrastructure minister stated that more than 50 railway workers have died on duty. Passengers on the Dnipro-Odesa route face hours-long delays and repeat evacuations due to Russian drone threats, with some stations in the east and south shut indefinitely as fighting creeps closer.

stories.title: Vossloh Fastening Systems expands product range and high-speed rail business
stories.summary: Vossloh Fastening Systems secured two contracts worth approximately EUR 60 million to supply System 300 rail fastenings for high-speed railway projects in Shandong Province, China. The company will manufacture the components at its Kunshan plant, with deliveries beginning in 2027 for lines designed for speeds of up to 350 km/h.

stories.title: China’s robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
stories.summary: Chinese embodied AI companies raised 93.5 billion yuan ($13 billion) across 322 deals in the first half of 2026, five times the amount a year earlier, according to data research firm ITjuzi. The funding shift reflects a strategic pivot from hardware manufacturing to developing software that allows robots to learn unfamiliar tasks and adapt without extensive reprogramming.

also.title: Chinese robot makers raise $13B as the industry pivots from bodies to brains
China’s Robotics Industry Shifts Focus from Humanoid Stunts to AI Intelligence

stories.title: The Pentagon Wants Millions of Autonomous Systems. Is North Carolina Ready for the Opportunity?
stories.summary: Secretary Pete Hegseth announced Project Agincourt on September 30, 2026, to accelerate the development and acquisition of autonomous systems. The initiative aims to expand the nation's autonomous arsenal from thousands to millions of units, with the Pentagon seeking $50 billion in reconciliation funding to support drone and robotic production.

stories.title: Russia Uses Cloud Cover for Geran Drone Strikes on Ukraine
stories.summary: Russia is using thick cloud cover to launch older Geran drones at targets in Ukraine, adviser Sergey Beskrestnov says, as strikes hit energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Texas's New Electric Air Taxis Are Taking Off - And They're Just The Beginning
stories.summary: Joby Aviation began test flights of its electric air taxis around Dallas-Fort Worth on September 10, operating from Perot Field Fort Worth Alliance Airport to DFW Airport, Arlington, and Plano. The company is in the fifth and final stage of the FAA's type certification process, with no date specified for when passengers can book flights.

stories.title: Cargill puts robotic hull cleaning to the test in Singapore
stories.summary: Cargill and Neptune Robotics launched an 18-month partnership to trial AI-powered robotic hull cleaning on vessels at the Port of Singapore. The program tests remotely operated robots and inspection technology under live conditions to measure cleaning efficiency and fuel savings, with results intended to support wider adoption of in-water hull maintenance across Singapore’s port network.

stories.title: FIU Detects Drones By The Magnetic Leak From Their Motors, No Radar
stories.summary: Engineers at Florida International University, Brookhaven National Laboratory, and the University of Ruhuna built a drone detector that listens for magnetic fields leaking from motors, achieving 98.5% accuracy at 49 feet. FIU announced the results on October 23, noting the sensor costs a few hundred dollars and is now being developed with U.S. industry.

stories.title: Antigravity A1 drone gets wearable controls for hands-free 360 filming
stories.summary: Antigravity announced the Follow Me Bundle, a new accessory package for its A1 drone that includes the Watch Remote and Ring Remote. The bundle also features Full-Coverage Propeller Guards and is available separately for existing A1 owners.

stories.title: Monstrous 13-foot mecha craves the dangerous jobs humans avoid
stories.summary: NeodraDynamics unveiled Neo1, a 13-foot, 1.2-metric-ton hydraulic-electric humanoid robot, at the China International Industry Fair in Shanghai. The company pitches the machine for heavy assembly, mining, and nuclear maintenance, with a stated payload of 500 kg using both arms.

stories.title: FCC 800 MHz Drone Order Adds a SpaceX Footnote the Draft Lacked
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission released its 800 MHz drone order on October 30, ending the 1991 airborne ban for drones at 824 to 849 MHz and 869 to 894 MHz. A new footnote notes SpaceX’s pending purchase of adjacent spectrum and states the FCC expects drones and SpaceX’s planned phone service to coexist there.

stories.title: Two young people injured in an FPV drone attack in Zaporizhzhia
stories.summary: An FPV drone attack in the Hradyzk community of Zaporizhzhia injured a 20-year-old girl and an 18-year-old boy with shrapnel wounds. Their condition is preliminarily assessed as not serious, and they are receiving medical care.

stories.title: From APKWS to LADAC: France joins the race for cheap laser-guided rockets to down drones
stories.summary: France has fielded the LADAC counter-drone system, integrating 68 mm laser-guided rockets into 12-tube launchers for Rafale and Mirage 2000 RMV aircraft. The program, developed by the DGA and the French Air and Space Force, aims to replace expensive MICA missiles with cheaper munitions to counter massed drone raids.

stories.title: Trucks VC Says It Has Seen 81 Autonomous-Vehicle Startups in 2026
stories.summary: Trucks Venture Capital reported observing 81 new autonomous-vehicle startups in 2026, a higher count than any complete year since the firm launched in 2015. The firm attributes this increase to foundation models enabling end-to-end driving systems, though it has not identified the specific companies or models involved.

stories.title: Pakistan military spokesperson says ready for drone warfare — Dawn
stories.summary: ISPR Director General Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry stated that Pakistan’s armed forces possess higher operational readiness for drone use than the Afghan Taliban and India. He claimed Pakistan shot down dozens of high-tech drones during the May 2025 conflict with India and asserted that the Taliban lack independent military capabilities.

also.title: Pakistan capable of intercepting any drones sent from Afghanistan India DG ISPR

stories.title: Rocket Lab founder Peter Beck takes delivery of Jetson One eVTOL
stories.summary: Sir Peter Beck, founder and CEO of Rocket Lab, ordered a Jetson One Founders Edition eVTOL after a test flight in California. The aircraft is expected to make its first flight with Beck by Christmas, subject to regulatory approvals.

also.title: Rocket Lab Founder Peter Beck Finds Pure Joy During First Jetson One Flight Over California

stories.title: French Army Moves to Standard 3 of Its Proteus Counter-Drone System
stories.summary: The French Army’s Technical Section (STAT) announced it has begun developing the third standard of its Proteus counter-drone system. This update electrifies the weapon mount and optimizes AI algorithms to shorten reaction time and improve hit accuracy.

stories.title: Rail Tank Cars Market Forecast to Expand Toward 2035, Driven by Fleet Renewal and Chemical Logistics Demand
stories.summary: IndexBox forecasts the global rail tank car market will grow at a compound annual growth rate of 2.5% to 3.5% through 2035, driven primarily by replacement demand and regulatory compliance deadlines in North America and Europe.

stories.title: Christchurch commuter rail pilot to be funded
stories.summary: Rail Minister Winston Peters and Regional Development Minister Shane Jones announced that the Regional Infrastructure Fund will provide a $3.4 million loan to Mainland Rail for a 12-month commuter trial in Christchurch starting in mid-2027. The service will run morning and evening trains from Rangiora and Rolleston into central Christchurch, with the Rolleston trip expected to take less than 20 minutes. The funding also supports establishing the Christchurch-Dunedin-Invercargill Mainlander as a regular service, subject to local councils confirming their share of costs.

stories.title: Sudan says drone attacks from Ethiopia killed, wounded hundreds
stories.summary: Sudan accused Ethiopia of enabling drone attacks that killed or wounded hundreds of civilians and soldiers since mid-February. The army-led Transitional Sovereignty Council documented 70 attacks between February 15 and October 27 involving 187 one-way attack drones and 82 munitions.

stories.title: DOE Launches Battery Manufacturing Initiative to Strengthen U.S. Supply Chain
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy launched the Battery Manufacturing Accelerator on October 28, uniting four national laboratories and five universities to improve domestic battery production. Pacific Northwest National Laboratory leads the effort, which aims to reduce electrode scrap rates from 40% to less than 5% using artificial intelligence and automated systems.

stories.title: FEMA’s $250 Million Counter-Drone Grant Deadline Approaches: Applications Due November 16
stories.summary: The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) is accepting applications for $250 million in counter-drone grants under its Fiscal Year 2027 Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS) Grant Program. Applications are due November 16, 2026, at 5 p.m. Eastern, with awards anticipated in December 2026.

stories.title: Poroshenko handed over six modernised «Ai-Petri» systems to the Ukrainian Armed Forces to combat drones
stories.summary: Petro Poroshenko handed over six modernised «Ai-Petri» anti-reconnaissance systems to the Ukrainian armed forces to counter Russian «Geranium» and «Gerbera» drones. The systems, funded by an unnamed NATO member state, are due to begin operations at designated positions on 2 November 2026.

stories.title: Russia Is Reshaping Air Warfare With AI Drones That Hunt Without GPS While Building Its Own Starlink
stories.summary: Russia is mass-producing AI-driven attack drones and developing an independent satellite-based weapons control system, while relying on foreign parts. Ukrainian officials stated that Russian industry produces up to 3,000 Shahed drones and approximately 700 Geran-5 drones each month, with new export licensing requirements expected to take effect on November 18.

stories.title: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as drones damage Russian facility
stories.summary: Russian strikes cut power to hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians across four regions on Sunday, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, while Governor Gleb Nikitin reported significant damage to an unidentified industrial facility in Nizhny Novgorod region following Ukrainian drone attacks.

also.title: Russia, Ukraine trade drone strikes as Zelenskyy urges air defense aid

stories.title: This Week in TSLA: Elon Musk's Apple Mac Studio Jibe, Former Autopilot Lead's Vision-Only Criticism and More
stories.summary: Tesla said Latvia authorized its Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, giving the technology approval in its 10th European Union country. Latvia’s Road Traffic Safety Directorate recognized provisional EU type approval issued by the Dutch vehicle authority RDW.

stories.title: 28 Zero-Day Findings in Less Than Two Days: What AI-Speed Discovery Means for Robotics
stories.summary: VicOne identified 28 zero-day vulnerabilities in less than two days using AI-assisted research across software supporting the Physical AI ecosystem, including projects by Google, NVIDIA, and Meta. The findings span development, simulation, and deployment stages, with researchers demonstrating a vulnerability that prevented a robot’s remote-stop command from working.

stories.title: Bullet Train Corridor to connect Bengaluru with Hyderabad & Chennai, Vande Bharat linking Bengaluru & Mangaluru soon: Vaishnaw
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the South Bullet Train corridor will connect Bengaluru with Hyderabad, Amaravati, and Chennai, with the Bengaluru-Chennai journey expected to take 73 minutes. He stated that a Vande Bharat service between Bengaluru and Mangaluru will launch in the coming weeks after electrification and testing work is completed.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shoots down drone over Riyadh region
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia’s air defenses intercepted and destroyed an enemy drone over the Riyadh region, the coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen said. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: "Excellent progress": Ashwini Vaishnaw after inspecting manufacturing of India's first bullet train in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw inspected the manufacturing of India's first bullet train at BEML in Bengaluru, stating that all major components are being produced, integrated, and tested. He also flagged off the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper train, which is fully booked for the next three weeks.

stories.title: Why physical AI is the next lucrative frontier
stories.summary: Genesis AI recently unveiled the Eno robot to bring physical AI into commercial environments. Robotics and physical AI startups raised a record $27.6 billion across 1,009 deals in 2025, more than double the prior year, according to PitchBook.

stories.title: Ukraine: Fiber-optic drone maker unsure if greater range worth trade-off
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone maker TechEx is reconsidering whether to extend fiber-optic drone ranges beyond 40 kilometers because heavier spools and batteries reduce payload capacity. The company is weighing the trade-off between increased range and the ability to carry explosives or high-quality cameras for front-line missions.

stories.title: Modi govt transformed Railway sector, Karnataka gets Rs 7,700 crore annually for development: Pralhad Joshi
stories.summary: Union Education Minister Pralhad Joshi stated that Karnataka receives Rs 7,000 crore to Rs 8,000 crore annually for railway development, up from Rs 700 crore in 2008. He noted that more than 150 Vande Bharat trains operate across the country and that railway accidents declined from 134 to 16 with the introduction of the Kavach railway protection system.

stories.title: Harop-like loitering munition offers clues about North Korea’s future unmanned-aerial warfare
stories.summary: North Korea displayed Harop-like loitering munitions equipped with electro-optical targeting systems and rocket-assisted launchers during an exhibition reported by state media KCNA on Friday (October 30). The drones, which closely resemble Israel’s Harop but use a distinct exposed metal launch structure, are designed to overwhelm enemy air defenses and threaten radar sites and command centers.

stories.title: Solving the Interconnect Challenge in Modern Robotics: How 3M Is Engineering for Motion, Density, and Uptime
stories.summary: 3M developed high-flex cable assemblies for robotics that are tested to 45 million or 100 million flex cycles, and introduced reduced-pitch connectors that double contact density on standard 0.100-inch grids. The company also offers Insulation Displacement Contact termination, which saves up to 80% in wiring time compared with crimp-style connectors.

stories.title: U.S. Marine Corps wants new cargo drones that fly 100 pounds 40 miles out
stories.summary: The U.S. Navy is inviting companies to bring cargo drones to Huntsville, Alabama, from Jan. 25 to Feb. 5, 2027, to compete for the U.S. Marine Corps’ second-generation Tactical Resupply Unmanned Aircraft System, or TRUAS Increment II, which must carry 100 pounds (45 kg) to a point 40 nautical miles (74 km) away and fly back without refueling. Applications to take part in the demonstration are due Nov. 30, 2026.

also.title: Navy Plans Heavy-Fuel Cargo Drone Fly-Off to Overhaul Marine Resupply Range

stories.title: California county deploys autonomous firefighting drones with 500-gallon foam payload to attack wildfires — five-drone strike team can be controlled by a single operator, conduct nighttime ops, and access difficult terrain
stories.summary: The San Bernardino County Fire Protection District acquired five autonomous firefighting drones from Seneca Systems, which can deliver over 500 gallons of foam under the supervision of a single pilot. The system is designed for rapid response, including nighttime operations and difficult terrain, and is expected to enter service ahead of the 2027 wildfire season.

stories.title: Drone 'used for surveillance' crashes into CTD headquarters in Lahore
stories.summary: Police in Lahore said a drone crashed into the Counter Terrorism Department headquarters' outer wall on Sunday. Authorities seized the device, which had operational cameras and battery lights, and launched an investigation to identify the operator and purpose of the alleged surveillance.

stories.title: State Launches Midwest Drone Test Site
stories.summary: Indiana launched the Midwest UAS Test Site in Terre Haute, one of nine uncrewed aircraft systems test sites designated by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). The initiative, led by the Applied Research Institute and Indiana Economic Development Corporation, is now accepting members and supporting flight-test operations for companies and researchers developing drone technologies.

stories.title: OpenAI Tests GPT-6.2 Astra Amid GPT-6 Robotics Dominance
stories.summary: OpenAI is testing GPT-6.2 Astra, which users spotted in Codex analytics, with a full public release potentially arriving as early as next week. The current GPT-6 Astra model topped the Robot Intelligence Index at 1,905 points and outperformed Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 in enterprise evaluations for speed and cost.

stories.title: Russian forces attack communities near Ukraine's Lviv with drones, damaging houses
stories.summary: Russian drones attacked the Lviv community on the morning of November 1, damaging five residential buildings, a car, and a warehouse, according to Lviv Mayor Andrii Sadovyi. Preliminary reports indicate no one was injured and no fires were reported at the sites.

stories.title: Bengaluru-Pune bullet train could be among next high-speed corridors Vaishnaw
stories.summary: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that Prime Minister Narendra Modi approved 4,000 km of bullet train corridors, with another 3,000 km planned for announcement in the coming years. Vaishnaw indicated the Bengaluru-Pune route could be among the next high-speed projects and said the Bengaluru-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express would launch within weeks after completed electrification and testing.

stories.title: Ukraine flies the first drone rescues of wounded troops
stories.summary: Brave1, a defence innovation cluster working with the Ministry of Defence, executed the first drone rescue of wounded troops in October. A Heavy Shot Ayudag-6 hexacopter carried an infantryman of the 30th Separate Mechanised Brigade more than fifteen kilometres to safety, meeting requirements to carry 130 kilograms and operate without satellite navigation.

stories.title: Sadiq Khan calls for cap on numbers of robotaxis on London streets
stories.summary: London Mayor Sadiq Khan called for a cap on robotaxis, questioning the impact of driverless vehicles on air quality, congestion, and jobs. He urged the government to ensure regulation is fit for purpose before a mass rollout, noting that Transport for London currently lacks the power to manage or license these services.

stories.summary: New York’s next governor should put high-speed rail on track

stories.title: Why Did russia Use Mostly Conventional Shahed Drones in Its Latest Attack on Ukraine?
stories.summary: Russian forces launched 433 attack drones on Ukraine, using only 64 jet-powered variants. Serhii Beskrestnov said widespread cloud cover likely influenced the choice, as overcast skies make it harder for Ukrainian interceptor-drone crews to detect incoming targets.

stories.title: Robot Valuations Take Off First, as Capital Starts Rethinking the Math
stories.summary: Physical Intelligence is in talks to raise at least $1 billion at a target valuation of roughly $20 billion, while Unitree Technology reported first-three-quarter revenue of 1.817 billion yuan and a third-quarter net profit decline of 17.37% year on year.

stories.title: In the Kirovohrad region, drone debris damaged power lines
stories.summary: Debris from Russian drones damaged power lines, an educational institution, and agricultural storage facilities in the Novoukrainsky District of the Kirovohrad region on the night of November 1. Utility workers are preparing to restore electricity, while the regional military administration reports no casualties.

stories.title: Romania scrambles four fighter jets due to drone incursion
stories.summary: Romania's Ministry of National Defence scrambled four F-16 fighter jets and an IAR-330 SOCAT helicopter after radar systems detected two unauthorized drones entering the country's airspace on the evening of 31 October. Alerts were issued in six counties, including Iași and Suceava, while one drone left the airspace and the other was last spotted between Vaslui and Bacău.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Hours Hit 20 a Day, Until 2 AM [2026]
stories.summary: Tesla extended its Robotaxi service hours to 20 daily, running from 6 AM to 2 AM, as announced on Oct. 30, 2026. The update also added a rear-view camera feed, trip sharing, and Grok on Model Y robotaxis.

stories.title: Ukraine tests drone for evacuating wounded soldiers.
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense technology company Skyfall delivered its Stargate unmanned aerial vehicle to a Ukrainian combat brigade for front-line evaluation. The six-propeller drone carries a 150 kg payload over a 15 km range to evacuate wounded soldiers, significantly reducing extraction times in areas where ground access is dangerous.

stories.title: From robot learning to conducting...SI Industry's 'RX' Crash
stories.summary: Samsung SDS is conducting about 10 robot demonstration projects at Samsung affiliate sites and plans to launch a robot orchestration platform next year. LG CNS is commercializing its PhysicalWorks platform, which integrates robots from various manufacturers, and recently introduced the system at LG Electronics' robot data factory.

stories.title: China Tech Trends: 3D Printing Hits Consumers, Humanoid Robots Drop to RMB 9,998, and DeepSeek Builds Its Own Chips
stories.summary: Bambu Lab turned desktop 3D printing into a consumer hit, Noetix launched a humanoid robot at RMB 9,998, and DeepSeek began in-house chip development as Chinese tech firms accelerate vertical integration across EVs, robotics, and AI infrastructure.

stories.title: China's Matrix Robotics to Set Up R&D Center in Korea Next Year
stories.summary: Chinese humanoid robot maker Matrix Robotics plans to establish a joint research and development center in South Korea next year to co-develop physical artificial intelligence technology with Korean companies, universities, and research institutes. The company aims to gather robot training data from manufacturing and service sites to strengthen general-purpose task capability and develop robots tailored to the Korean market.

stories.title: Flights prevented from landing at airport by 'illegal and persistent' drones
stories.summary: Drones prevented four flights from landing at Jersey Airport on Saturday evening, forcing British Airways flight BA1356 to return to London and diverting an ASL Airlines plane to Paris. Jersey’s chief minister, Senator Lyndon Farnham, stated that a police investigation is ongoing and that authorities are exploring counter-drone technology with UK partners.

stories.title: How German billionaire skipped college and learned robotics on YouTube to build $7B company
stories.summary: Neura Robotics, a German startup founded by David Reger in 2019, secured financing worth up to $1.4 billion led by Tether with backing from Nvidia and Amazon, valuing the company at approximately $7 billion. The firm, which develops humanoid robots and industrial arms, opened a €17 million training center near Munich Airport on Oct. 22 where around 100 robots learn practical skills.

stories.title: Russia launched 433 drones at Ukraine overnight; air defense forces shot down 371
stories.summary: Russia launched 433 strike drones at Ukraine on the night of November 1, with air defense forces shooting down 371 targets. Hits were recorded at 16 locations, and debris fell at 14 additional sites, while more than 40 drones remained in the air as of 7:30 a.m.

stories.title: World's longest underwater railway tunnel will cost $4.3bn and stretch 17km
stories.summary: China is constructing the Yong-Zhou Railway, a 76-kilometre route linking Ningbo and Zhoushan that will feature the world's longest submerged railway tunnel. The project, funded by an investment of 27bn yuan (approximately $4.3 billion), is anticipated to reach completion in 2028.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone forces commander reports monthly record: one target hit every 41 seconds
stories.summary: Robert "Magyar" Brovdi, Commander of Unmanned Systems Forces, reported that his units hit 64,807 targets and inflicted 16,796 Russian personnel losses in October. Brovdi stated these figures represent a record for the grouping since the start of the full-scale war, with a daily average of 542 Russian soldiers killed.

stories.title: Watch: NASAâs pencil-thin X-59 supersonic jet spotted flying across US skies
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 experimental supersonic jet began a cross-country journey from California to Florida on Wednesday, marking one year since its maiden flight. The aircraft, which reached a top speed of Mach 1.53 and 56,000 feet altitude in its first year, is now moving toward acoustic validation to help regulators assess noise standards for commercial supersonic flights over land.

stories.summary: Drones attacked the LUKOIL-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez oil refinery in Kstovo, Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod Region, causing a fire on November 1. Monitoring channels reported the strike occurred despite Russian air defense repelling previous attempts, while local authorities have not officially commented on the incident.

stories.title: HD Hyundai Robotics Cuts Robot Fix Time 63% With Palantir AI
stories.summary: HD Hyundai Robotics said on 1 November that AI agents built with Palantir Technologies cut the average time to resolve robot-related problems from 21.5 days to 7.9 days since it began deploying them in August. The company also says it expects the agents to cut robot programming costs by more than 50%.

stories.title: FCDO updates Spain travel warning after Toledo rail crash
stories.summary: The UK’s Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office updated its Spain travel advice on 28 October 2026 following a deadly high-speed rail collision between Mora and Orgaz. The FCDO warns of significant disruption on key routes connecting Madrid with southern regions, advising travelers to contact RENFE or the nearest British embassy for assistance.

stories.title: South Korea’s Navy Recasts Its Light Carrier as a Drone Carrier for the 2040s
stories.summary: South Korea’s navy told the National Assembly on 20 October 2026 that it is converting its light aircraft carrier program into a 30,000-ton manned-unmanned teaming carrier, with fielding targeted for the early 2040s. The Joint Chiefs of Staff are currently reviewing the requirement change, which was submitted in October 2025.

stories.title: Russia’s Shadow Fleet Turns to Nets and Rubber Tires for Makeshift Drone Armor
stories.summary: Russian shadow fleet tankers have displayed nets, metal cages, and rubber tires while transiting the Bosporus since August, according to images reviewed by The Wall Street Journal. At least 60 ships have been documented using these makeshift antidrone devices to protect engine components and rudders from Ukrainian drone strikes.

stories.title: NEPIRC manufacturing event provides education about AI, robotics
stories.summary: Steve Esposito, production engineering manager for Gentex Corp., said the company now uses a GrayMatter Robotics vision system to sand helmets in about seven minutes, down from 15 minutes manually. Esposito stated Gentex introduced about 10 automation systems in the last year to increase capacity for the U.S. Department of Defense.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Rider Covers 74 Miles Across Houston in One $133 Trip
stories.summary: A Houston Robotaxi rider logged 74.1 miles and 3 hours 5 minutes for $133.25 on Saturday, running from the northern edge of Tesla’s expanded geofence to the southern edge and back to the same starting point.

stories.title: The supersonic fantasy: technically feasible, commercially unviable
stories.summary: Scott Kirby, CEO of United Airlines, stated that the Overture supersonic aircraft will not begin carrying passengers in 2029 as originally planned. Boom Supersonic aims to conduct flight tests in 2027, but the timeline remains uncertain due to certification challenges and commercial viability concerns.

stories.title: LUXEED and AiMOGA Robots: Co-Building the Future of Mobility Through a Connected Human-Vehicle-Home Ecosystem
stories.summary: AiMOGA opened global pre-orders for its MOBO family companion robot on October 21, 2026, in Wuhu, China. The company has delivered more than 3,000 units across more than 60 countries and regions, integrating its robots with LUXEED vehicles to synchronize data and capabilities between driving and home environments.

stories.title: General Atomics, Hoeven unveil new Reaper drone operations at GRAND FORKS AFB
stories.summary: General Atomics completed its Remote Split Operations facility at Grand Forks Air Force Base on Friday, enabling MQ-9 Reaper drone pilots to conduct U.S. Africa Command missions from North Dakota instead of forward locations. U.S. Sen. John Hoeven stated the shift is estimated to save the military around $10 million per year by retaining personnel and reducing forward deployment costs.

stories.title: Tesla's Cybercab Reaches Dallas in November, and Nevada Just Cleared 5,000 Robotaxis in Las Vegas. Here's the Number That Makes the Bulls Right.
stories.summary: Tesla plans to expand its Cybercab presence in Dallas in November, while Nevada regulators authorized the company to operate up to 5,000 fully autonomous vehicles in the Las Vegas area during its first year under the new permit.

stories.title: How Turkey’s submarine-hunting drones could challenge the Israeli Navy
stories.summary: Turkey demonstrated its Bayraktar TB3 naval drone during the Sea Wolf exercise on September 22, deploying acoustic buoys to detect submarines in the eastern Mediterranean. The drone processed sonar data in real time, linking with crewed aircraft to identify targets for engagement by warships or the AKYA torpedo.

stories.title: Ukraine Risks Losing Jet Drone Production to Europe, Expert Says
stories.summary: Military analyst Valery Shiryaev warned that Ukraine faces higher jet drone costs as production, tax revenue, and technical expertise remain in Europe. He argued that Ukraine’s limited domestic manufacturing capacity forces reliance on European suppliers, preventing cost reductions through economies of scale.

stories.title: From the cockpit of an F-22, a pilot acted as an airborne quarterback for a YFQ-44A Fury in October, handing it tactical directives instead of stick-and-rudder commands; Anduril says it was a first for the Raptor and the pre-production drone.
stories.summary: An F-22 Raptor pilot issued high-level tactical directives to a YFQ-44A Fury drone during a flight from Edwards Air Force Base in California in October 2026. Anduril says the test was a first for an F-22 and a pre-production YFQ-44A, with the Air Force planning for pilots to control several drones as a formation.

stories.title: North Korea Displays Stealth Drone as Missile Tensions Rise
stories.summary: North Korea displayed a mockup of a large, tailless flying-wing aircraft at the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Development-2026 exhibition on Thursday, where Leader Kim Jong Un attended and called for "absolute superiority" in drone technology. The aircraft features a dorsal air intake and retractable landing gear, with an estimated wingspan of 56 to 66 feet, while North Korea simultaneously launched approximately 10 short-range ballistic missiles from the Wonsan area toward the Sea of Japan.

stories.title: B28 Bullet Train Clears Safety Test Before 2027 Trials
stories.summary: BEML completed a vehicle body shell squeeze test for India’s indigenous B28 bullet train at its Bengaluru facility. The central public sector undertaking is manufacturing the first two eight-coach trains, designed for 249 kmph operation and testing up to 275 kmph. The Railways plans to begin trial runs on the 100-km Surat-Vapi section in May or June 2027, with commercial operations scheduled for August 2027.

stories.summary: Archer Aviation signed an agreement with ITA Airways to develop electric air taxi services across Italy using the Archer Midnight aircraft. The partnership aims to establish short-duration routes between 10 and 20 minutes, with Rome Fiumicino Leonardo da Vinci International Airport listed as a potential deployment location.

stories.title: Amazon drops Westborough drone delivery plan after pushback
stories.summary: Amazon withdrew its application to the Town of Westborough for a drone package delivery launch site, according to a statement from local lawmakers. The company requested approval to withdraw its site plan review application without prejudice after facing pushback over noise, safety, and privacy concerns.

stories.title: NATO’s DiBaX 2026 in Latvia: 5G, Counter-Drone and AI Targeting Tested on One Network
stories.summary: NATO’s Allied Command Transformation tested 5G communications, layered counter-drone defense, and AI-assisted targeting in Latvia from October 19 to 30. The trials, hosted by Latvia’s Ministry of Defence, involved participants from six nations and more than 60 companies, with a final demonstration on October 30 at the Ādaži military training area.

stories.title: Tesla’s Driverless Cybercab Carries 2 Skeleton Riders for Halloween
stories.summary: Tesla's Robotaxi account posted a 19-second video on October 31, 2026, showing a driverless Cybercab with two skeleton figures inside. The clip, captioned "Bone voyage," served as a seasonal promotion following the service's recent extension of hours to 2 a.m. and the addition of Share and Calm Mode.

stories.title: Drone violates Moldovan airspace amid Russian attacks on Ukraine
stories.summary: Moldova's National Army detected an unauthorized drone in its airspace on Saturday 31 October, flying from Ukraine's Odesa Oblast toward Transnistria. The military introduced airspace restrictions over northern and central Moldova and urged the public to call 112 if they find suspicious debris.

stories.summary: Tesla logged 4.1 million unsupervised robotaxi miles yesterday, with 1,325 estimated unsupervised vehicles in Texas and Florida. The company will add 300 Cybercabs for Dallas and 300 for Houston in November, reaching 2,000 vehicles in Texas and Florida.

stories.title: RO-Alert activated in Romania due to possible appearance of drones
stories.summary: Romania's National Military Command Center activated the RO-Alert system in Iași county after the Ministry of National Defense detected an air target 10 kilometers from the Moldova border. Two F-16 fighter jets took off from Campia Turzii air base to monitor the target, while residents were instructed to take refuge in basements or stay indoors away from windows.

stories.title: Bigwave Robotics Hosts BIGWAVE SHIFT 2026 Industrial Physical AI Summit in Seoul
stories.summary: Bigwave Robotics hosted the BIGWAVE SHIFT 2026 Industrial Physical AI Summit at SKY31 in Seoul, South Korea, on October 22, 2026. The event featured nine sessions by eight companies, including NVIDIA and DexRobot, and included a demonstration of Bigwave's Hyper Foundry platform.

stories.title: U.S. Startup Builds Flying Blanket to Hide Vehicles From Drones and Satellites, Four Drones Stretch IR/Radar-Blocking Cover Overhead
stories.summary: American company Vigil Autonomy presented its Air Cover asset, a flying blanket with four drones that conceals vehicles and infantry from infrared and radar detection for two hours. The system uses artificial intelligence to autonomously follow moving targets, though the article notes the development is in early stages and questions its practicality against angled thermal imaging or synthetic aperture radar.

stories.title: British Air Force New Protector RG1 Drone Tracks Russian Warships in First UK Space Sorties
stories.summary: The British Royal Air Force flew its Protector RG Mk1 drones in the English Channel between late September and mid-October 2026 to track Russian naval activity. The unarmed aircraft generated more than ten hours of surveillance alongside Royal Navy vessels, marking their first operational sorties in UK airspace.

stories.summary: The Pentagon’s acting head of the Defense Innovation Unit stated the U.S. is “starting from basically zero” on mass-producing cheap military drones, targeting 250,000 units by the end of 2027 with $1.1 billion in committed funding.

stories.title: Monthly Drone Report – October 2026
stories.summary: The U.S. military is expanding its focus on autonomous warfare, including a new Army Special Operations robotics warrant officer specialty and plans for an Autonomous Warfare Command. Ukraine continues to demonstrate rapid drone innovation, employing unmanned systems for precision strikes, battlefield deception, and medical evacuation.

stories.title: Californians revolt against police drones after rapid adoption across state
stories.summary: The San Francisco Police Department asked commissioners to approve a policy allowing drones for public safety response, active investigations, training, and community outreach, while prohibiting random general surveillance. Commissioners voted to advance the policy to labor negotiations without adding a warrant mandate, despite residents urging the department to cancel its contract with drone manufacturer Skydio.

stories.title: Canadian Mayor Alarmed at Trump’s Naval Drones Surveilling the Great Lakes
stories.summary: The US Coast Guard deployed Saildrone autonomous naval drones across the five Great Lakes in May, funded by a $15.5 million proviso in Trump’s “One Big, Beautiful Bill Act.” Mayor Mike Bradley of Sarnia, Ontario, expressed alarm after seeing a drone on the St Claire River, citing a failure to communicate with Canadian counterparts.

stories.title: Kongsberg lands contract boost to expand underwater drone capabilities
stories.summary: Kongsberg Gruppen ASA will supply autonomous underwater vehicles and components under a $54 million contract modification from the Department of War Innovation Unit (DIU), extending its collaboration with the US Navy. The company stated that AUV contracts signed across defense and commercial markets total NOK 1.7 billion in 2026.

stories.summary: China's GJ-21 stealth drone completed its first takeoff and landing aboard the Sichuan, the country's first Type 076 amphibious assault ship, a navy source said. The vessel, which has a full-load displacement of over 40,000 tonnes, features electromagnetic catapult and arrestor technologies and began sea trials in November 2025.

stories.summary: Taras Bublyk, head of Ukrainian defense company Unwave, stated that modern drones can continue carrying out combat missions even after losing communication or navigation signals. He explained that the development of mesh networks means the suppression of a single communication channel no longer necessarily results in the loss of control over the drones.

stories.title: Drones attacked Moscow; explosions were heard near Sheremetyevo Airport
stories.summary: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin reported that 11 drones had allegedly been shot down on the outskirts of the Russian capital. A column of black smoke was spotted near Moscow's Sheremetyevo Airport, with OSINT analyst Astra identifying the fire source in a forest near the “Sheremetyevo Fuel and Refueling Complex” warehouse.

stories.title: The Future of Florida Transit: Electric Air Taxis Take Flight Over Tampa Bay
stories.summary: An all-electric air taxi completed a demonstration flight from Albert Whitted Airport in downtown St. Petersburg to Tampa International Airport under the federal eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. Early deployment one-way flights across Tampa Bay will cost between $150 and $220.

stories.title: Another CEO bites the dust on California’s train to nowhere
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, chief executive officer of the California High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned Wednesday night, citing “personal and family priorities.” The rail authority board named state Department of Finance director Joe Stephenshaw as interim CEO a day later.

also.title: California High-Speed Rail approves Siemens trainsets, ends Phase 1 environmental review

stories.title: FAA restriction grounds drones, limits private flights during Trump visit
stories.summary: The FAA restriction, NOTAM 6/3803, began at 7:59 p.m. Friday and is scheduled to end at 12:30 p.m. Sunday. It covers airspace up to 17,999 feet above sea level within a 30-nautical-mile radius of Palm Beach, with stricter limits inside a 10-nautical-mile radius.

stories.title: Edward Johns Tests the One-Demonstration Robot
stories.summary: Edward Johns’s company Machenta published a packaging-line demonstration on October 27 featuring three bimanual robots it said it taught in two minutes. The London startup announced a $40 million seed round co-led by Creandum and Union Square Ventures to scale a model trained entirely in simulated environments.

stories.title: Northrop Grumman wins $56 million deal to upgrade Triton surveillance drone
stories.summary: Northrop Grumman received a $55,986,538 Navy contract modification on October 28 to install a B7 upgrade kit on one MQ-4C Triton drone by May 2030. The work will occur primarily in Palmdale and San Diego, though the Navy has not confirmed whether the upgrade adds IFC-4 signals intelligence capabilities.

stories.title: Unusual robotic animals can prove their utility
stories.summary: Korean researchers at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) developed a beetle-like soft robot to address practical and humanitarian problems, such as searching for victims in collapsed buildings where traditional rescue methods are hampered by rubble.

stories.title: Airbus U.S. demonstrates remote control handover for unmanned UH-72 in Marine Corps logistics program
stories.summary: Airbus U.S. Space & Defense demonstrated remote control handover for an unmanned UH-72 Logistics Connector during its seventh flight test in Grand Prairie, Texas. The test, conducted with Shield AI, L3Harris Technologies, and Parry Labs, validated autonomous behaviors and precise takeoffs and landings to support Marine Corps logistics from dispersed locations.

stories.title: Shafaq News..Baghdad explores Canadian drone technology for border security
stories.summary: Iraq is exploring Canadian drone surveillance and counter-drone technologies to strengthen border security, National Security Adviser Qassim Al-Araji said on Saturday. Al-Araji discussed aerial reconnaissance and countermeasures with Robert Johnston of Arcanus Aerial Systems, emphasizing the government's interest in acquiring advanced security equipment.

stories.title: Florida Conducts First Demonstration Flights Under US Electric Air Taxi Integration Programme
stories.summary: The Florida Department of Transportation conducted its first demonstration flights under the Federal Aviation Administration's Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing and Advanced Air Mobility Integration Pilot Program on October 30, 2026. Joby Aviation and BETA Technologies operated electric aircraft along the historic St. Petersburg–Tampa route, with BETA reporting 14 flights covering nearly 700 nautical miles.

also.title: BETA Technologies Completes 14 All-Electric Flights Across Florida Under U.S. DOT and FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program

stories.title: Here's How Much More High-Speed Rail China Has Than Every Other Country
stories.summary: China has laid more than 31,000 miles of high-speed rail track since 2008, a distance exceeding the rest of the world combined. The International Union of Railways counted 28,204 miles in China in 2024, representing about 70% of the global total, while Spain holds the second spot with 2,481 miles.

stories.title: In 2021, Boeing’s MQ-25 drone passed 325 pounds of fuel to a Navy Super Hornet — the first midair refueling delivered by an unmanned aircraft
stories.summary: Boeing's MQ-25 T1 drone transferred 325 pounds of fuel to a Navy F/A-18 Super Hornet on June 4, 2021, marking the first midair refueling by an unmanned aircraft. The Navy expects initial operational capability for the MQ-25A in 2029.

stories.title: After Uber Destroyed Taxi Cabs, Drivers Now Face the Existential Threat of Self-Driving Cars
stories.summary: In Cambridge, Massachusetts, a coalition including the App Drivers Union, Boston Carmen’s Union Local 589, and Teamster’s Local 25 warned local lawmakers about the threat of Waymo vehicles mapping roadways for an eventual autonomous rollout. The group demanded city action to preserve drivers’ jobs, citing evidence from Atlanta where Waymo’s arrival in summer of 2025 led to lower pay and fewer fares for rideshare workers.

stories.title: Next US stealth drone could stay airborne for over two days without refueling
stories.summary: General Atomics announced it is designing a new flying-wing drone called NextGen, targeting more than 60 hours of unrefueled endurance. The company hopes to have a live-firing demonstration of the drone by early 2027.

stories.title: First soldier to be evacuated from battlefield by drone is awarded Hero of Ukraine title
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded the title of Hero of Ukraine to Kostiantyn "Magura" Vlasenko, who spent 491 days in the grey zone and continued combat missions despite serious wounds. The president also awarded the Medal for Saving a Life to Private First Class Vasyl Prokopyvniuk, who led the first-ever evacuation of a soldier by drone.

stories.title: Economy | SW China's Guizhou launches its first campus low-altitude drone delivery route
stories.summary: Guizhou launched its first campus low-altitude drone delivery route in Qingzhen vocational education town. The service connects commercial districts to campuses, reducing delivery times to under 20 minutes with fees starting at 3.8 yuan.

stories.title: Russian Mi-8 Escapes Ukrainian Drones Midair, Lands Straight Into a Deadly Trap
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian Mi-8 military helicopter using two Hornet strike drones in the occupied Luhansk region after pursuing the aircraft and striking it once it landed, Ukraine’s Third Army Corps reported on October 30. The operation was carried out by the SKYFOM strike-wing platoon of the Third Assault Brigade’s unmanned systems battalion during a mission targeting Russian military logistics.

stories.title: EHang Will Send a Fleet of 25 Autonomous eVTOLs to Thailand
stories.summary: EHang announced plans to deploy a fleet of 25 EH216-S aircraft to Thailand as part of its own expansion strategy to establish a regional hub for Southeast Asia. The company scheduled validation flights for November in Sri Lanka, Vietnam, and Malaysia, and plans demonstration flights in Bangkok during the ICAO AAM Symposium in December 2026.

stories.title: Ukraine uses robots to protect humans, but some soldiers are still at risk
stories.summary: Ukraine is using a growing fleet of war robots to take dangerous roles away from humans, but soldiers sometimes still need to risk their lives to keep the machines running. Oleksandr Yabchanka, head of the robotic systems for Ukraine's Da Vinci Wolves Battalion, told Business Insider that "at present, human involvement is both mandatory and indispensable."

stories.title: Coratia Technologies Raises Rs 18 Cr For Navy Robotics
stories.summary: Coratia Technologies raised Rs 18 crore in a bridge round led by MGF Kavachh to execute a Rs 66 crore contract with the Indian Navy. The funds will accelerate research and development and expand underwater robotics manufacturing and deployment.

stories.title: Finland orders 21 more Stadler Sm7 trains for tendered services from 2031
stories.summary: State-owned RailStock Finland ordered 21 more Stadler Sm7 trains worth about €240 million for subsidized passenger services from 2031, bringing the Sm7 fleet on order to 41. The company signed the order in the last week of October and announced it on October 30.

stories.title: Drone pilots suffer ‘exhaustion and distress’ miles from battlefield
stories.summary: A British medical study published in BMJ Military Health found that military drone crews suffer high levels of exhaustion, psychological distress, and suicidal thoughts despite operating thousands of miles from the battlefield. The review of 14 studies indicated that up to one in 12 operators reported suicidal thoughts, while 25 to 37 percent experienced high emotional exhaustion.

stories.title: ​Pantsir Air Defense Systems Can't Even Protect Themselves, Yet India Wants Them to Guard Its S-400s Against Drones
stories.summary: India is reportedly considering the purchase of 13 Pantsir air defense systems to protect its S-400 batteries against drones. The proposed allocation includes 10 systems for the Air Force and three for the Army, though no official confirmation of the plans has been issued.

stories.title: Poland’s Drone Spending to Hit $6.6B in 2026; First MQ-9B Delivery in January
stories.summary: Poland’s Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz announced on October 30 that drone spending will reach 26 billion złoty in 2026, up from 100 million złoty in 2023. The country expects its first MQ-9B SkyGuardian drone in January 2027 under a $310 million contract signed with General Atomics in December 2024.

stories.title: Avengers Assemble! US rolls out Stinger missiles to shield Trump's Florida estate from drone threats
stories.summary: The North American Aerospace Defense Command and US Northern Command deployed Avenger short-range air defence systems armed with Stinger missiles around President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida. The systems were positioned at multiple locations, including a floating platform in Lake Worth Lagoon, a nearby beach, and Donald J Trump International Airport, following a request from the US Secret Service.

stories.summary: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw highlighted the proposed Northern Corridor for the bullet train, approved by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, which would reduce travel times such as Delhi to Kanpur to 1 hour 45 minutes and Varanasi to Patna to 1 hour.

stories.title: Denel’s Skyler Drone Debuts at AAD as SANDF acquisition Talks Advance
stories.summary: Denel publicly debuted its Skyler unmanned aerial vehicle at the Africa Aerospace and Defence 2026 exhibition, two weeks after presenting it to President Cyril Ramaphosa. The company is in advanced discussions with the South African National Defence Force about the system, which features a 25-kilometre operating radius and up to 150 minutes of endurance.

stories.title: ‘First’ insurance policy for domestic humanoid robots in the UK
stories.summary: Tokio Marine HCC International and Adrian Flux launched the UK’s first domestic humanoid robot household insurance policy, available to UK customers through Adrian Flux’s home insurance offering. The policy covers robot damage, theft, sudden home damage, personal liability, and emergency recovery, with domestic robots expected in UK homes from 2027.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics raises $100 million to build ‘America’s first autonomous factory for assembly’
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics announced a $100 million Series A funding round led by Marlinspike Partners to build out its 130,000-square-foot Emeryville facility and accelerate AI model deployment. The company plans to grow its robotics research and factory operations teams to serve defense and commercial industries with autonomous assembly for complex electro-mechanical products.

stories.title: What ever happened to Lamont's '30-30-30' vision for Connecticut rail?
stories.summary: Gov. Ned Lamont announced a goal in 2019 to cut travel times to 30 minutes between Hartford, New Haven, Stamford, and New York, but current averages remain significantly higher. The state broke ground this summer on a $1.6 billion project called TIME-1, with construction expected to wrap up in 2035.

stories.title: CISF Drone Security Plan for Critical Infrastructure
stories.summary: The Central Industrial Security Force signed a Memorandum of Understanding with IIT Hyderabad’s Technology Innovation Hub on October 31, 2026, to provide trainees with instruction in drone assembly and autonomous systems. The partnership supports the force’s proposed Centre of Excellence for Drone and Anti-Drone Technology at its Recruit Training Centre in Behror, Rajasthan.

stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo announced plans to introduce purpose-adapted autonomous electric vehicles to the UK, beginning with testing of Toyota bZ4X models in Japan during 2027. Toyota will manufacture the vehicles at its Takaoka plant, installing Waymo’s autonomous driving hardware during production rather than after assembly.

stories.title: Vande Bharat is the fastest, but Tejas arrives early: Chennai to Madurai Vande Bharat, Vaigai superfast trains face 8-17 minutes delay while Tejas express reaches destination before scheduled time
stories.summary: A six-month study found that the Vande Bharat Express reaches Madurai 17 minutes late on average, while the Tejas Express arrives 12 minutes early. The Vaigai Express is eight minutes late, and Vande Bharat remains the fastest train despite its delays.

stories.title: SynDexy dexterous manipulation humanoid robot, completes first small-batch delivery
stories.summary: SynDexy announced on Oct. 30 that its SynDexy C1 dual-arm wheeled humanoid robot completed its first small-batch delivery. The units are headed for precision assembly lines at consumer electronics and component factories, marking the product's transition from R&D validation into engineering-grade deliveries.

stories.title: Orbbec Signs 10,000-Unit Procurement Agreement with ACE Robotics
stories.summary: Orbbec signed a 10,000-unit procurement agreement with ACE Robotics to supply depth cameras, RGB cameras, and non-embodied data-acquisition hardware. Deliveries are already underway, with the hardware integrating into ACE Robotics' systems to capture multi-view data for training embodied AI models.

stories.title: Lingyi iTech Q3 Revenue and Net Profit Hit Record Highs, Robotics Business Enters Mass Production and Delivery Phase
stories.summary: Lingyi iTech reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of 15.52 billion yuan and net income of 1.15 billion yuan, both record highs. The company began mass delivery of humanoid-robot components and fully built machines from assembly lines in Beijing, Chengdu, Zhengzhou, and Dongguan.

stories.title: The former head of TFU presented the Drone Security Index, which will show the readiness of European states to drone threats. How will this be determined?
stories.summary: The New Age Defence platform and BRDO presented the Drone Security Index, a methodology assessing European states' preparedness for drone threats across prevention, detection, counteraction, and recovery. The first pilot assessment of Germany and Poland begins in November 2026, with plans to expand to 16 more countries in 2027.

stories.title: Air defenses down 105 out of 134 Russian drones launched at Ukraine overnight
stories.summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 105 of 134 Russian drones launched since the evening of October 30. The attack included 72 jet-powered Shahed drones, with hits recorded at 20 locations and power outages reported in Kyiv.

stories.title: From AP To Mumbai: Driverless Metros In Record Time!
stories.summary: Alstom delivered its first of 39 driverless Metropolis trains for Mumbai Lines 4 & 4A to the city after manufacturing them in 14 months at its Sri City facility in Andhra Pradesh. The trains, designed and built in the state, are set to begin daily operations soon.
